title: Export Market Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake analyzes trade data, extracts market signals from unstructured sources, classifies export opportunities, and generates AI briefs — replacing fragmented trade intelligence with unified analytics

talking_points: Thai food exports: ฿1.1T this year. Top markets: Japan (18%), USA (12%), China (11%), EU (15%).
Seven new trade barriers detected this quarter affecting ฿45B in export revenue.
show: Point at export revenue by market treemap
tabs.call_out: ฿45B at risk from new barriers — 12 new opportunities identified

transition.line: Let's explore the highest-potential new markets.

talking_points: AI scores 50+ markets by attractiveness: tariff advantage, demand growth, competitive gap.
Saudi Arabia halal prepared meals: score 92 — FTA pending, demand up 35%, no Thai competitor established.
AI_EXTRACT identified the opportunity from 3 separate trade signals last month.
tabs.call_out: AI-scored market opportunities — from signal to strategy

transition.line: What about threats to our existing markets?

talking_points: Vietnam shrimp exports to Japan up 22% — taking Thai market share. ML detects inflection point.
EU new regulation on antibiotic residue limits — affects ฿12B in Thai seafood exports.
Cortex Complete generates strategic response brief with recommended actions.
